title: Lp Orchestrator Plan Output
description: Output of the *plan task (Nova). The canonical contract every downstream agent reads.

landingPagePlan.description: landing-page-plan.md — product overview (name, value prop, audience, Schwartz awareness level, goal, tone) plus a per-section plan for all 11 sections (objective, key message, visual elements, CTA, notes to copywriter/designer).

sectionBriefs.description: section-briefs/ — one brief per section derived from the plan, used by Quill (copy) and Pixel (design) as the per-section spec.

executionOrder.description: execution-order.md — ordered agent/command sequence for the 6 phases (copy, design, images, build, review).
